newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger confident of NZ First decision on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bolger confident of NZ First decision on Tuesday.

text.p: New Zealand's caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Monday he expected New Zealand First to make a decision on its coalition partner on Tuesday.

"I anticipate a decision tomorrow. I think it will require some extraordinary intervention at this late stage for us not to have a decision tomorrow," Bolger told journalists as he entered a National Party caucus meeting.
Bolger also confirmed that the party's strategy committee would meet on Monday evening.
Under the party's rules, the strategy committee is the body that provides the final, official ratification of the deal National is prepared to offer NZ First.
The committee consists of three members from the party and three from the parliamentary caucus.
